# Twist & Thrive Systems

> Twist & Thrive Systems is a one-person practice in Boulder County, Colorado, run by Gina Harrison. It builds client systems, websites, and pricing for small independent businesses: intake forms, booking, automated follow-up, client portals, and service packages. Pricing is fixed per deliverable, never hourly. The only free service is a 20-minute Kickoff Call.

Founder: Gina Harrison. 15+ years in customer experience and operations at Conga, Movable Ink, and Swrve. Certified Dementia Practitioner.
Location: Boulder County, CO. Serves Boulder, Lafayette, Louisville, Denver, and remote clients across the US.
Contact: consultwithatwist@gmail.com. Book a call: https://calendly.com/twistandthrivesystems

## Pricing
- Kickoff Call: free, 20 minutes.
- Clarity Audit: $350, credited toward any build or package started within 30 days.
- Online booking setup: $200. Booking connected to your calendar, with confirmations that send themselves.
- Intake form: $250. One form that collects what you need and lands it in one place, with an automatic confirmation email.
- Price sheet or service menu: $250. Your services and prices, designed so people can actually read them.
- Follow-up email sequence: $300. Up to three emails: reminders, check-ins, or a nudge to rebook.
- Client welcome packet: $300. A branded, reusable packet you send every new client instead of rewriting it.
- Link-in-bio page: $300. A simple page for your Instagram that sends people straight to booking.
- One website page: $350. One page, written in your voice and built. A new service, an about page, a landing page.
- Payment link and receipt: $200. A payment link for a service or deposit, with a confirmation email.
- Get Paid What You're Worth: from $900. For owners who set their prices once and haven't touched them since.
- Get In Front of the Right People: from $1,200. For owners who know who they help but can't reach them consistently.
- Get Found: from $1,500. For owners whose website doesn't match their work, or who don't have one.
- Get Organized: from $1,800. For owners whose days fill up with scheduling and follow-up instead of clients.
- Custom Builds (portals, apps, dashboards): from $4,500. 50% to start, 50% on delivery.
- Monthly Access: Essentials $750/month, Partner $1,800/month. Three-month minimum.
- Payments over $1,000 can be split into two or three installments.
